SourceIntelligence MCP Server — Cross-Platform Service Installer
Version 1.0.0

USAGE
  sourceintelligence-installer --repo <path> [--port <port>]
  sourceintelligence-installer --uninstall
  sourceintelligence-installer --status
  sourceintelligence-installer --help

OPTIONS
  --repo <path>   Absolute path to the repository to index  [required for install]
  --port <port>   HTTP port the MCP server will listen on   [default: 5200]
  --uninstall     Stop and remove the installed service
  --status        Show current service status
  --help, -h      Show this help message

PREREQUISITES
  The SourceIntelligence global tool must be installed before running the installer:
    dotnet tool install -g SourceIntelligence

PLATFORMS
  Windows  — Windows Service via sc.exe         (requires Administrator)
  Linux    — systemd unit                        (system: requires root / user: no root)
  macOS    — launchd LaunchAgent (~/.../LaunchAgents)  (user-level, no root needed)

EXAMPLES
  sourceintelligence-installer --repo /path/to/myproject
  sourceintelligence-installer --repo /path/to/myproject --port 5300
  sourceintelligence-installer --uninstall
